areas.ag: Rhode Island Dept. of Environmental Management
areas.t: Unseasonably mild and dry weather on tap for this week. For Tuesday, sunshine and temps into the 70s. SW winds allow fine particles to MODERATE.  Lingering fine particles into Wed early before more southerly flow pushes in cleaner ocean air. Temps in the upper 60s, lots of sun. Some increased clouds
